policy: Custom flat icon family drawn for Certificate Flow Lab. Not official Microsoft icons. No external icon assets are used.

icons.label: Person
icons.description: A person (visitor, owner or operator)

icons.label: Client computer
icons.description: A desktop computer with a monitor

icons.label: Browser window
icons.description: A web browser window with a padlock

icons.label: Server
icons.description: A rack server

icons.label: IIS web binding
icons.description: A web site with a globe, representing an IIS HTTPS binding

icons.label: Certificate request
icons.description: A document with a key hole, representing a CSR

icons.label: Policy gate
icons.description: A shield with a checklist, representing template policy

icons.label: Issuing CA
icons.description: A server with a certificate seal, representing the online Issuing CA

icons.label: Offline Root CA
icons.description: A server with a padlock, representing the offline Root CA trust anchor

icons.label: Database
icons.description: A database cylinder

icons.label: Publication server
icons.description: A web server publishing PKI files

icons.label: AIA repository
icons.description: A certificate with a download arrow, representing issuer certificate download (AIA)

icons.label: CDP / CRL repository
icons.description: A list with a blocked entry, representing a certificate revocation list (CDP)

icons.label: Certificate
icons.description: A certificate with a ribbon

icons.label: Trust decision
icons.description: A shield, representing the trust decision

icons.label: Domain Controller
icons.description: A server with a directory tree badge, representing a Domain Controller

icons.label: Certificate store
icons.description: A drawer holding certificates, representing a certificate store

icons.label: Private key (stays on DC01)
icons.description: A key with a padlock: the private key, which never leaves DC01
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Document (INF or CRL)
icons.description: A plain document page
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: CSR
icons.description: A sealed envelope: the certificate signing request (public key and names, signed by the DC01 key)
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Package
icons.description: An open box with content chips: a transfer or return package (no private key)
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Request record
icons.description: A ledger row: the CA request record (Request 1042)
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Issued leaf
icons.description: A certificate with a ribbon: the issued DC01 certificate
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Accepted leaf
icons.description: A certificate with a key badge: the accepted DC01 certificate linked to its private key
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Issuing CA certificate
icons.description: A certificate with a "CA" tab: the public Issuing CA certificate (no private key here)
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Root CA certificate
icons.description: A certificate with an anchor: the public copy of the Root CA certificate, the trust anchor
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Chain
icons.description: Three stacked mini-certificates: leaf, Issuing CA, Root
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Error record
icons.description: A warning triangle: an error record
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Identity card
icons.description: An identity card: the names the certificate must carry
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Template card
icons.description: A form with policy lines: a certificate template
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Enrollment wizard
icons.description: A dialog window with a progress bar: the Request New Certificate wizard
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Remediation card
icons.description: A checklist: follow-up and remediation items
icons.use: DC story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Browser warning
icons.description: A browser window with a warning triangle: the certificate warning on CLIENT01
icons.use: Website TLS story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Problem report
icons.description: A speech bubble with text lines: the visitor's problem report
icons.use: Website TLS story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: IIS site binding
icons.description: A site window with a globe and a padlock: the IIS https binding on WEB01
icons.use: Website TLS story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: TLS handshake message
icons.description: Two opposing arrows: a TLS handshake message (ClientHello, CertificateVerify)
icons.use: Website TLS story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)

icons.label: Trusted connection
icons.description: A closed padlock with a check mark: the trusted connection
icons.use: Website TLS story artifact vocabulary (always paired with its fixed text label and colour token)
